goal: Make unattended batches never commit to, create or switch a user-visible branch: preflight has one dirt rule and no side effect, and batch progress and Lane integration live on a hidden ref with results applied to the working tree, under S2 of docs/specs/content-delivery-authority.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Sources E4, U4; meet S2, SCN-2 and D9 in docs/specs/content-delivery-authority.spec.md: preflight never commits; a rejected preflight leaves HEAD, branch, index and git log unchanged; dirt outside every unsettled child's scope (including docs/specs, docs/plans, .imm/audit and a settled child's paths) does not block; dirt inside an unsettled child's scope blocks with the named paths.

Sources E6, U3, T2; meet D10 in docs/specs/content-delivery-authority.spec.md: a batch with serial and Lane children advances only refs/imm/batches/<batch_id>; the user's checked-out branch, HEAD and index never move; each integrated Lane's scoped delta appears in the working tree; a conflicting local edit on those paths parks that child with the named paths; under Git integration auto each applied delta is committed through the S3 settle commit with only its scoped paths.
